# Primitives

<div class="odv-pagehero"><div><p>The raw values of Content first. Primitives hold the values; semantic tokens give them a job (see <a href="../foundations/">Foundations</a>), and components read only the jobs. Colour ramps stay whole, so some colour steps wait for a use; every other primitive is read by something.</p><div class="odv-stats"><span><b>109</b>Primitives</span><span><b>76</b>In use</span><span><b>33</b>Spare</span></div></div><span class="odv-robot odv-pagehero-robot"><img class="odv-robot-day" src="/robots/content-first.webp" alt="" loading="lazy"/><img class="odv-robot-night" src="/robots/content-first-dark.webp" alt="" loading="lazy"/></span></div>
